title: Adam the Firstborn
intro: Adam the Firstborn is a Level 88 V Blood Carrier.
location: Doctor Blackbrew's Castle in Gloomrot North
description: The culmination of Doctor Henry Blackbrew's brilliance, The Monster was to be the next step of human evolution, the ultimate machine of war. It is as powerful as Blackbrew could have ever desired but proved impossible to control. The Trancendum has done everything it can to contain The Monster, and they've been successful in doing so... for now.

attacks.name: Lightning Towers
attacks.desc: The arena which Adam is fought within has eight lightning towers, two on each wall. Towers opposite one another create a continuous stream of lightning that deals damage and slows the player as long as they remain within it. A pair of towers can be deactivated by dealing sufficient damage to one of the towers. Adam will start the fight by activating all towers. Occasionally, Adam will reactivate a pair of towers. He can do this in both phases.

title: Albert the Duke of Balaton
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Albert the Duke of Balaton is a Level 64 V Blood Carrier.
description: The patriarch of a family that once held land when these swamps were adequately inhabited. Over time, the cursed land twisted them, leaving this horrible, twisted toad that only remembers its lust for gold and jewels. It jealously guards its hoard of forgotten, worthless currency.

title: Alpha the White Wolf
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Alpha the White Wolf is the lowest level (Level 16) V Blood Carrier in V Rising, and likely the first that a player will successfully hunt. The Alpha Wolf will attack any non-wolf creatures that it meets along its path. Interestingly, if the player is in Wolf Form the Alpha Wolf will ignore them.
description: The trail of this scent bears the unmistakable signature of Dracula, the Immortal King. When Dracula fell, he cursed the world of Vardoran with a blood rain, a scourge in which many perished. Some who survived became unknowingly twisted by the downpour, their bloodlines forever empowered by his malice. This mighty predator is infused with that legacy.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.desc: Standard melee attack.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.desc: The Alpha Wolf will crouch down for a second in preparation and then launch itself forward in a straight line.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.desc: The Alpha Wolf howls and glows red, launch itself in a straight line and bite 2 times.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.desc: The Alpha Wolf stops for a moment, howls, and summons 2 regular wolves to join the fight.

title: Angram the Purifier
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Angram the Purifier is a Level 61 V Blood Carrier.
location: Pools of Rebirth in Gloomrot South
description: A dedicated servant of the Trancendum, Angram was an exterminator that possessed a natural cruelty and resilence unmatched by any of his peers. Like any good soldier, he gave his life for his cause... or tried to, anyway. Doctor Henry Blackbrew could not let such an asset go to waste and brought him back to life with a brutal surgery few other beings could survive. Angram lives now, at the mere cost of every last scrap of his humanity.

title: Azariel the Sunbringer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Azariel the Sunbringer is a Level 79 V Blood Carrier.
description: A true politician, Azariel wormed his way to the top of the ranks of the Church of Luminance with cold, calculated social grace. Few can match his power and dedication to the Light short of Solarus the Immaculate himself, and none within the church would dare contradict his word.

title: Bane the Shadowblade
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Bane the Shadowblade is a Level 50 V Blood Carrier.
description: Once a formidable swordsman and legendary graverobber, Bane was caught by the Cult of the Damned during one of his many heists. Seeing the benefit of his talent for infiltration, instead of killing him, they corrupted him into a servant of undeath. It's said that his clandestine abilities were crucial in the capture and corruption of the Iron Mine over the Militia.

attacks.name: Triple Slash
attacks.desc: He will slash at you three times. Third attack is a lunge which will incapacitate you.

attacks.name: Triple Knife Throw
attacks.desc: He will dash away from you and throw three knives at you.

attacks.name: Dark Spin
attacks.desc: His phrases will be all about Darkness or Black magic, He will do a purple AoE slash that surrounds him.

attacks.name: Teleport Strike
attacks.desc: He will teleport out of view and reappear near you to strike, which will incapacitate you.

attacks.name: Into the Shadows
attacks.desc: He will say one of his few phrases emphasizing he will disappear, but will summon a multitude of cloaked figures (much like when you hit him to start the fight), he will be one of them, damaging one that is not him will summon Skeletal Warrior and Undead Assassins.

attacks.name: Shadow Clone
attacks.desc: At less then 50% health, his dash from the knife throw will leave a lingering shadow which will also throw knives at you.

attacks.name: Brutal and Incursion Rift
attacks.desc: : His Knife attack can be chained multiple times in a row. For Incursion only, his Into the Shadow move will have an aura above him, but the minions spawned are Draculin mobs.

title: Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier is a Level 70 V Blood Carrier.
description: Formerly a traveling swordsman-for-hire, the good baron earned his title of Grand Sommelier after winning a taste contest hosted by the Church of Luminance. His abilities were so extraordinary, it's said that he can name the ingredients, their ages, and their place of origin with only a sip of brew. Though his new position offers him all the worldly goods he could desire, those who know him well suspect he may miss the taste of blood on the tip of his blade most of all.

attacks.name: Barrel roll
attacks.desc: Baron drinks of his wineglass, causing two or three waves of barrels to roll from one side of the room to the other side. they deal heavy damage and stun on hit. Cannot be blocked, but can be damaged and destroyed. Baron himself will jump over them, cancelling any ability he is casting.

attacks.name: Wine bolt
attacks.desc: Baron charges and throws a wine bolt, dealing damage.

attacks.name: Counter
attacks.desc: Baron stands still while blocking any projectile or attacks hitting him. Area targeted abilites may still damage him.

attacks.name: Barrel dance
attacks.desc: baron starts a barrel dance, causing barrels to roll from the entrance side of the room to the other side. these can be dodged and don't usually need to be destroyed.

title: Beatrice the Tailor
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Beatrice the Tailor is a Level 40 V Blood Carrier.
description: The most talented tailor in all of Vardoran. Though the legacy of Dracula’s blood runs through her veins, she has proven far more charming than dangerous.

title: Ben the Old Wanderer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Ben the Old Wanderer is a Level 63 V Blood Carrier.
description: This old survivalist seeked to explore the Cursed Forest, despite knowing it's dangers. As the curse began to cloud his mind, he found ways to fight against it. With his cloak and a helpful little wisp he'd captured in a lantern, his strange magical defense prevented the curse from taking full control. Though it was too late to prevent his mind from falling to tatters, he still does what he does best... survive.

attacks.name: Knockback
attacks.desc: He'll swing his staff and knockback the player.

attacks.name: Wisps
attacks.desc: He'll release 3 wisps that inflict Entangled, immobilizing the player for a couple seconds.

attacks.name: Brutal and Incursion
attacks.desc: While his fight remains unchanged by running away, he will summon his wisps as he gets damaged too.

title: Christina the Sun Priestess
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Christina the Sun Priestess is a Level 44 V Blood Carrier.
description: When the Church of Luminance first discovered the abilities granted by the blood rain, they took it as a blessing from the Light, incidentally masking the truth of Dracula’s influence. Christina is one such faithful servant of the church. This cruel disciplinarian takes her continued mastery of Light as evidence that her torturous methods of enforcing her beliefs are a necessary tenet of her faith, and she very much enjoys proving her righteousness.

attacks.name: Staff Swipe
attacks.desc: If the player or a minion is in melee range of her, she raises her staff and swings it in a medium arc in front of her after a brief delay.

attacks.name: Holy Rays
attacks.desc: She aims her staff like a gun, before firing 5 fast-moving holy missiles in a fan in front of her.

attacks.name: Holy Wrath
attacks.desc: She plants her staff in the ground and calls down an AoE beacon of holy light upon the player's position after a brief delay. The AoE slows the player's movement before exploding after a couple seconds delay.

attacks.name: Shining Blessings
attacks.desc: After she has lost health, she occasionally shouts "Shining Blessings!", raises her staff in the air, and becomes stationary while slowly healing herself. She cannot use any other abilities while channeling this one. Abilities which stun enemies (such as the Iron tier and higher Axes' X-Strike ability) will interrupt her healing.

attacks.name: Conviction Counter
attacks.desc: If the player is close to her, she shouts "This is my conviction!", surrounding herself in Holy light and counters all incoming attacks. Anyone who hits this counter will be silenced for several seconds.

attacks.name: Summon Militia
attacks.desc: She shouts "I will show you discipline!" and summons a Militia Crossbowman and Militia Guard to come to her defense.

title: Clive the Firestarter
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Clive the Firestarter is a Level 30 V Blood Carrier.
location: Bandit Sulphur Quarry in Farbane Woods
description: An unparalleled genius in the explosive arts. Unfortunately for Grayson, this chaotic psychopath is far too useful to get rid of at providing and mixing destructive materials. He'll burn down his entire camp just to take you with him, laughing all the while.

attacks.name: Cluster Bomb
attacks.desc: He throws a bomb in the air which explodes and splits into 3 more bombs, then explodes again and splits into 9 bombs.

attacks.name: Time Bomb
attacks.desc: He drops a large bomb at his feet with a large explosion radius that takes a couple seconds to explode.

title: Cyril the Cursed Smith
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Cyril the Cursed Smith is a Level 65 V Blood Carrier.
description: Cursed with eternal life and servitude to the Cult of the Damned, Cyril has little desire to perform his duties. However, having been traded to the Cult before he had even been born, this tortured life is all he knows. Resigned to his fate, he does still take some small joy in inflicting his pain on others.

attacks.name: Sword
attacks.desc: Dash forward, then cleave

attacks.name: Spear
attacks.desc: Dash backward, then throw a piercing spear

attacks.name: Mace
attacks.desc: Levitate, then slam down and create spheres in a ring around the caster, spirally traveling outward.

attacks.name: Slashers
attacks.desc: Slash trice, then Dash forward and backward.

attacks.name: Create weapon
attacks.desc: Cyril creates a new spectral weapon to fight alongside him.

attacks.name: Create multiple weapons
attacks.desc: Cyril creates all four spectral weapons. starting at 50% health

attacks.name: Dash
attacks.desc: Cyril will dash four times in a row. starting at 30% health.

title: Dantos the Forgebinder
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Dantos the Forgebinder is a Level 82 V Blood Carrier.
location: Venom Blades Bastion in Oakveil Woodlands
description: Dantos is a master of weapons, fascinated by both their construction and application. A true obsessive, his borderline inhuman dedication to his craft made him an excellent tool for his Queen, the great witch Megara. After a time, their monstrous similarities brought them closer, and Dantos became her personal strategist as well as a close confidant. Inspired by Megara's secrets, it was Dantos who discovered that Venom Sap could be used to separate magical alloys, allowing the fusion of powerful artifacts into even greater weapons.

title: Domina the Blade Dancer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Domina the Blade Dancer is a Level 60 V Blood Carrier.
description: Originally an engineer responsible for advancements in practical electrical weapons, Domina's incredible advancements were born of her hands-on, reckless approach to testing. Though this approach led to her demise, she was brought back to life by the maddening machinery of the infamous Doctor Henry Blackbrew. Domina's sadism and masochism are unlimited, unmatched, and perhaps unstoppable in her pursuit of protecting and "policing" the people of Gloomrot.

title: Dracula the Immortal King
intro: Dracula the Immortal King is a Level 91 V Blood Carrier.
location: Dracula's Castle in Ruins of Mortium
description: When Dracula fell centuries ago, it seemed like the Church of Luminance had done the impossible. The death of the Immortal King. However, in his final moments, Dracula enacted his final gambit and cast a cloud over Vardoran. The blood rain that followed would plant the seeds of Dracula’s will across the realm, twisting it, and filling it with his storied essence. After death, the Immortal King’s soul was cast out to where his otherworldly powers originated, the Shadow Realm. There he lingered, biding his time. Now the time has come. Dracula floods the world with his monstrous Legion of Noctum, having them gather the blood necessary for him to become whole once more and return to Vardoran.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.desc: Whenever the Player is out his reach, he will teleport and do his stab, slash, or axe attack.

attacks.name: Wolf Rush
attacks.desc: He will transform into a wolf and rush behind you and will slash at you.

attacks.name: Crimson Slasher
attacks.desc: He will swing his sword vertically twice shooting beams from right to left.

attacks.name: Dread Stab
attacks.desc: He will teleport and Stab you with his sword, which will also Incapacitate you.

attacks.name: Blood Wave
attacks.desc: He will stab his sword into the ground causing six beams to rush out.

attacks.name: Howling Axes
attacks.desc: He will teleport away from you in one of the corners of the arena to throw two axes that circle towards you and then back to Dracula. They can be blocked by a pillar or ward. They may change course dramatically if Dracula uses a teleport while they are in flight.

attacks.name: Crimson Bats
attacks.desc: Will use this move at 75%, often paired with his Teleport.

attacks.name: Bloody Spiral
attacks.desc: Dracula begins shooting out a spiral of blood bolts in 3 directions at once. Meanwhile a ring closes in on you. If you remain in the ring its whole duration you will be stunned and then hit backwards.

attacks.name: Writhing Crimson Night
attacks.desc: He will teleport out of view, darken your screen and summon crimson bats that will partial predict your movement, which can be destroyed, blocked or dodged. Afterwards he will reappear near you summoning a circle and if in too long, will grab you and drain some of your Blood, throw you and Stun you.

attacks.name: Vampiric Curse
attacks.desc: A status effect that will be inflicted if you are hit by most of his attacks. Has no direct effect, but after the timer runs out an explosion will occur with its centre at the location of the player. This can damage your fellow vampires except for Dracula himself. The damage can be dodged however if you are immaterial during the explosion from veil, mist trance or abilities with such effects. (Note: Vampiric Curse effect does not apply if there is only one person fighting him)

attacks.name: Blood Wave MKII
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase version of Blood wave, functions the same, but at the end of the waves span will spawn blood pools which will explode.

attacks.name: Crimson Slasher MKII
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase version of Crimson Slasher, but will send 2 more beams following the pattern.

attacks.name: Blood Crystal
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase move. He will beckon at you and wave his hand to summon a Crystal. The crystal will circle around the arena projecting an aura, touching said aura will damage you. Can be destroyed. He may do this multiple times.

attacks.name: Blood Sword Rain
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase Attack. He will summon swords that rain down on you, with small area of effect.

attacks.name: Nightstalker Clone
attacks.desc: Phase 2 attack. He will summon a visibly shadowy clone of himself to do his Dread leap. Can be ignored or destroyed.

attacks.name: Dread Leap
attacks.desc: He will jump at you with his sword extended outward.

attacks.name: Bloody Cross
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase move. He will teleport to the center of the arena with an indicator of a cross pattern, he will summon crimson flames and will shoot partial predicted blood bolts at your location. Dodge or ward the blood bolts.

attacks.name: Blood Bolt Wall
attacks.desc: 2nd Phase move. He will teleport, stand still and shoot a wall of blood bolts. Center often empty, or you can dodge or ward.

attacks.name: Brutal Only- Blood Vortex
attacks.desc: At the start of Phase 4, Dracula will summon a encroaching Blood vortex, the radius shrinks until there is very little walk space. It does continuous damage while standing in it.

attacks.name: Brutal Only- Shockwave
attacks.desc: During his 4th phase as the blood vortex shrinks, he will do a shockwave move (does no damage, like Henry Blackbrew the Doctor) to push you into the vortex.

title: Errol the Stonebreaker
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Errol the Stonebreaker is a Level 20 V Blood Carrier.
description: A brutal mining foreman, just as adept at crushing stone as he is crushing bone. Not even his incredible eye for recovering and refining metals was enough to stop him from getting run out of civilised society. His violent rage makes a fine motivator for the miners.

attacks.name: Aftershock
attacks.desc: At long range, he slams the ground creating a shock wave that explodes in a couple seconds.

attacks.name: Uppercut
attacks.desc: At short range, he runs at the player with an uppercut swing.

attacks.name: Knockback
attacks.desc: At short range, he does a spin attack that knocks the player back.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.desc: He whistles to summon 2 Miners.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.desc: When he shouts "Lets hear that crunch!" he slams the ground creating 4 shock waves that explode in every direction.

title: Finn the Fisherman
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Finn the Fisherman is a Level 32 V Blood Carrier.
description: Finn is a legendary fisherman who hails from the rocky shores of Silverlight Hills. Caught fishing in the Church of Luminance's "sacred" waters, he was set to be executed by live burial at sea. The fisherman emerged from the depths, mysterious and miraculously alive, and went into hiding in the safety of the lawless lands of the Farbane Woods.

attacks.name: Fish slap
attacks.desc: : A two hit combo where he slaps the player with a fish, then follows up with a kick.

attacks.name: Tornado
attacks.desc: : Winds up before performing a spin attack with his fishing pole that deals damage and knocks the player back.

attacks.name: Throw Net
attacks.desc: : Much like the Trapper ability, Finn swings a net around before throwing it into the AoE indicator. Players still in that zone when he throws the net will be pulled to Finn's location and briefly prevented from moving. Additionally, any piranhas and pufferfish hit by the attack are also pulled and can hit the player.

attacks.name: Summon Piranhas
attacks.desc: : Summons 3 Hungry Piranha enemies, which slowly chase the player while attempting to use a rapidly hitting melee attack.

attacks.name: Summon Pufferfish
attacks.desc: : Summons 3 Pufferfish enemies which deal damage and apply to any player they touch. Dealing any damage to a Pufferfish will cause it to be knocked away. If a Pufferfish is knocked into Finn, it will be killed and Finn will be briefly stunned. If a Pufferfish is killed by any other means it will fire 10 chilling projectiles in every direction around it.

attacks.name: Summon Serpent
attacks.desc: : Summons a Young Sea Serpent with a melee bite attack and ranged attack that launches 3 ice projectiles in a fan pattern and applies . Finn may use this attack multiple times if the fight lasts long enough, even if the first serpent is not killed.

title: Foulrot the Soultaker
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Foulrot the Soultaker is a Level 63 V Blood Carrier.
description: A mad cultist that claims to be the vessel of his decapitated horse, 'Foulrot the Soultaker.' He also claims his blades take their victims straight to 'The Great Darkness', an effort to feed or please some infernal power. Whether or not there's truth to his claims, his headcount is undeniable.

title: Frostmaw the Mountain Terror
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Frostmaw the Mountain Terror is a Level 53 V Blood Carrier.
description: An unspeakable horror that lurks in the snowy corridors of the Hallowed Mountains. Some say it used to be a simple woodsman. Most don't dare invoke its name at all.

attacks.name: Leap Slash
attacks.desc: He will leap towards you if you're too far away and slash at you.

attacks.name: Triple Slash
attacks.desc: he will swipe at you with his left, then right and his third will cover most of his sides and front.

attacks.name: Ice Lances
attacks.desc: He will throw three ice lances at you, applying if any hit.

attacks.name: Ice Nova
attacks.desc: He will slam his fist into the ground, summoning an ice nova.

attacks.name: Encumbering Blizzard
attacks.desc: Around 50% health he will summon a Blizzard, whiting out your screen, of which will spawn ice spikes from the ground. He will circle around you, leap and slash you.

attacks.name: Frigid Beam
attacks.desc: Less then 50% health, he will cover his mouth for a moment to signal the laser, of which he will sweep in a large area, and the laser will pierce through terrain like boulders and destroy trees, if hit it will you.

attacks.name: Brutal Mode and Incursion Rift
attacks.desc: : Most of it's attacks will now inflict instead of . His Ice Nova will come out much faster.

title: Gaius the Cursed Champion
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Gaius the Cursed Champion is a Level 55 V Blood Carrier.
description: Gaius was a skilled militia captain and a famous gladiator. Annoyed at Gaius' popularity competing with his own, as well as that of the Church of Luminance, Raziel arranged for his defeat by way of a cursed blade. The event was devastating, and the Colosseum has been abandoned ever since... however, it is said that even today, issuing a challenge in the abandoned arena will be met with an answer.

title: General Cassius the Betrayer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ General Cassius the Betrayer is a Level 57 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrolling the roads of Ruins of Mortium
description: Once a highly skilled and respected officer within the ranks of the Church of Luminance, Cassius served as a powerful paladin who led a troupe tasked with hunting down Dracula himself. His mission ended in failure, overpowered by the Immortal King and forced into servitude. With the dark influence of his sentient blade, Nightfall Edge, affecting his mind, Cassius now serves as a loyal general for the Legion of Noctum.

title: General Elena the Hollow
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ General Elena the Hollow is a Level 53 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrolling the roads of Ruins of Mortium
description: Elena was once a talented weaver, a wife, a mother, and friend. Now she is none of those things. When Dracula’s forces descended on her village and harvested its people, she hid in the chaos and witnessed the horror first-hand. Discovered by the Immortal King himself, he saw an opportunity to twist a suffering creature to his whim. He shaped her into an ice-cold killing machine, a perfect servant for the Legion of Noctum.

attacks.name: Ice Arrow
attacks.desc: Elena does 4 simple bolt attacks in succession that apply .

attacks.name: Ice Bolts
attacks.desc: Elena shoots 5 freezing bolts, similar to the Longbow's Q ability.

attacks.name: Shard Rain
attacks.desc: Elena shoots out 15 bolts that are similar to the Crossbow rain of bolts. These arrows freeze the player and deal heavy damage.

attacks.name: Ice Pillar
attacks.desc: Elena raises an ice pillar from the ground, elevating her from attacks. The pillar can take damage and be destroyed early, and she can still attack while on the ice pillar. It disappears after 10 seconds.

title: General Valencia the Depraved
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ General Valencia the Depraved is a Level 84 V Blood Carrier.
description: Valencia was once a human baroness, part of an affluent noble family from before the great war. Always hungry for power, ambitious, and utterly without moral tethers, she saw the rise of Dracula and his legions as an opportunity to surpass her human limitations and become something greater. Impressed with her utter depravity, Dracula granted the baroness’ wish. Valencia now serves as a vicious general of the Legion of Noctum.

attacks.name: A Thousand Spears
attacks.desc: Valencia dashes backwards and thrusts her spears forward in a cone multiple times, not giving the player a chance to cast spells, dash, or attack. She always initiates the fight with this attack. She does this attack if you're close by after summoning Bloody Iron Maiden or being spit out by it.

attacks.name: Spear Throw
attacks.desc: She throws a single spear that pulls the player in. She does this attack if you're far away after summoning Bloody Iron Maiden or being spit out by it.

attacks.name: Bloody Iron Maiden
attacks.desc: At the 75% max health threshhold, she will place an Iron Maiden in the Center of the arena, which if near will drain 25% of your Blood Pool. Spins around slowly to face the player, and shoots out spears that pull the player in at range. Up close it will try to capture the player, dealing damage and stunning upon being spit out. Can be destroyed.

attacks.name: Thrust Kick
attacks.desc: She will glow red, and sprint behind the player and attempt to kick you into the Iron Maiden. Only happens while the Iron Maiden is active.

attacks.name: Spear Hail
attacks.desc: Valencia either dashes backwards a small distance or leaps a great distance away, before throwing many spears into the air and they crash down, creating small craters. Can happen at any point after the first Iron Maiden has been summoned.

attacks.name: Spear Spin
attacks.desc: Valencia spins her spears back and forth, damaging players who touch it and negating all damage from in front of her.

title: Gorecrusher the Behemoth
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Gorecrusher the Behemoth is a Level 84 V Blood Carrier.
description: Once a loyal warrior in the Legion of Noctum. So dedicated was his fanaticism that upon Dracula’s death to the hands of the Church of Luminance, the warrior severed his shield-bearing arm in an act of shame. In a delirious haze, he wandered into the wilderness of the Cursed Forest expecting to die. The corruption within gave him not death, however, but something much worse.

attacks.name: Swipes
attacks.desc: Gorecrusher will prepare before performing two wide swings followed by a thrust with his club arm.

attacks.name: Slam Combo
attacks.desc: Gorecrusher will let out a roar and begin to glow with Illusion magic before slamming down his club three times, once to his right then once to his left before slamming it straight ahead. Each of the slams stun the player if they connect.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.desc: Gorecrusher will prepare to charge a short distance. If the player is hit by the charge they will be flipped a long distance backwards and stunned.

attacks.name: Ground slam
attacks.desc: Gorecrusher will raise both his arms as a damage circle appears in front of him. When the circle fills up he will slam the ground, doing damage and knocking back the player if they are in the circle, as well as sending out 5 lines of shockwaves in random directions.

attacks.name: Leap
attacks.desc: If the player gets too far away from Gorecrusher, the Behemoth will leap at the player, signaled by a damage circle filling up. Gorecrusher will not leap if he's performing a charge attack.

attacks.name: Charge Combo
attacks.desc: At about 80% health, Gorecrusher will gain the ability to do 3 long range, non-stunning charges one after the other. Every charge will be delayed and they all will attempt to target ahead of where the player is moving rather than where the player is currently in an attempt to intercept them.

attacks.name: Illusionary Summons
attacks.desc: At about 70% health, Gorecrusher will jump away from the player (while unlikely, his jump away from the player can still deal damage to them if he lands on them). Afterwards, he will summon an illusionary wolf and illusionary bear to attack the player while also apply a warping effect to the screen similar to the Trippy Shroom for 15 seconds, during which time he is also immune. The illusionary animals will act similarly to their standard counterparts and will linger in the fight until they die and will not drop anything. Once Gorecrusher's immunity ends he will run up to the player before quickly slamming down with his club, stunning the player if it connects.

attacks.name: Wisp Dance
attacks.desc: At about 50% health, Gorecrusher will roar, slowing the player and casting a very powerful version of Wisp Dance which will summon a large amount of wisps from his very center. The wisps will linger on the field for a long time and, if they come into contact with the player, will deal damage and apply weaken , reducing their damage and movement speed.

attacks.name: Soul
attacks.desc: At about 30% health, Gorecrusher will stop to roar and knockback the player, summoning a Gorecrusher Soul in the process which is essentially an illusionary clone of himself. The clone is able to perform all of Gorecrusher's attacks independently of the real one except for his leap, his Wisp Dance and Illusionary summons. If the soul would die it will instead drop down becoming immune and will stop attacking while it regenerates. The soul will resume attacking once it reaches half health and the only way to kill the soul for good is killing Gorecrusher himself.

title: Goreswine the Ravager
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Goreswine the Ravager is a Level 27 V Blood Carrier.
location: Roams between the Desecrated Cemetery and the Infested Cemetery
description: A mad cultist, too far gone to be really intelligible. The Malevolent being they serve pushes them to desecrate all things, with little regard for practicality. They wear a rotting pig's head as a decorative mask.

attacks.name: Corrupted Skull
attacks.desc: A ranged attack that fires a single skull and snares the player if it hits.

attacks.name: Bone Explosion
attacks.desc: An explosion that covers the ground in a poison cloud.

attacks.name: Quad Explosion
attacks.desc: They shout "Suffer for us, suffer!", spawns 4 poison clouds total, and teleports elsewhere.

attacks.name: Ultimate Explosion
attacks.desc: At half health they shout "Drink it in, the chaos!", becomes temporarily invulnerable, spawns multiple poison clouds 3 times in a row, and teleports elsewhere.

title: Grayson the Armourer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Grayson the Armourer is a Level 27 V Blood Carrier.
description: The working arm and logistical mastermind of the bandit forces, Grayson is the backbone of their operation. As the quartermaster of a band of chaotic outlaws, murderers, and thieves, he's the stern voice of reason that keeps their gang well fed and well equipped.

attacks.name: Overhead Swing
attacks.desc: Basic melee attack.

attacks.name: Uppercut
attacks.desc: At short range, he runs at the player with an uppercut swing.

attacks.name: Get Over Here
attacks.desc: He throws 3 hammers which pull the player toward him if they get hit.

attacks.name: Knockback
attacks.desc: He shouts "I'm gonna hammer you out!" and does a spin attack that knocks the player back.

attacks.name: Caltrops
attacks.desc: He shouts "I've got the tool for the job!" and throws multiple caltrops to the ground, dealing damage and snaring the player if they step on them. They can be destroyed by equipping the invulnerability armors and walking over them. While invulnerable, the player cannot use any attacks.

attacks.name: Summon Minion
attacks.desc: He shouts "You can't stop me!" and summons a Poacher.

title: Grethel the Glassblower
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Grethel the Glassblower is a Level 50 V Blood Carrier.
description: A true artist with a deep love for the process of creation. She thinks of herself much like she thinks of her glass. It is beautiful and practical, chaotic and tame, strong and yet delicate. In the same way, her style of glassblowing is methodical and daring. While she is a master of her craft, she wears many savage burn scars for her haphazard approach.

title: Henry Blackbrew the Doctor
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Henry Blackbrew the Doctor is a Level 74 V Blood Carrier.
description: Doctor Henry Blackbrew was once humankind's last hope against the forces of Dracula, before the Church of Luminance came along. With their newly found faith and weapons of light, mankind turned on the Doctor for his sick methodology and pursuit of human evolution, declaring him a heretic. Banished alongside his students, he went on to found The Trancendum and began constructing a society in his image. With the help of a resource he refers to as "Blood Type E" he's managed to maintain his youth, and keep his twisted pursuit of "progress" alive for well over 800 years.

attacks.name: Lasers
attacks.desc: He'll shoot 4 lasers in every direction.

attacks.name: Homing Orb
attacks.desc: He'll shoot an electrical orb that tracks the player

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.desc: He'll shout "Try me now!" and do a counter attack.

attacks.name: Wall Lasers
attacks.desc: During the fight, lines of electricity will cross the room and disappear after a while. They can be crossed with a Dash ability.

attacks.name: Wall Orbs
attacks.desc: He'll charge one of the corners of the room and 4 waves of 4 electrical orbs will shoot out.

attacks.name: Knockback
attacks.desc: He'll charge up a skill at the center of the room and shoot 7 pulses of energy that try to push you against the wall.

title: Jade the Vampire Hunter
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Jade the Vampire Hunter is a Level 57 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrols the roads of Dunley Farmlands
description: A huntress from a noble house in Brighthaven, famous for their development of new-age weaponry that rivals even the genius of the scientists of Gloomrot. After the disappearance of her brother, rumor has it the expert marksman stole an impressive arsenal of experimental weapons to aid in her hunting down the culprit.

attacks.name: Shot
attacks.desc: The basic ranged attack.

attacks.name: Silence
attacks.desc: She'll fire a red bullet that inflicts Silence, rendering the player unable to attack for a couple seconds.

attacks.name: Caltrops
attacks.desc: She'll throw multiple caltrops to the ground, dealing damage and stunning if the player steps on it.

attacks.name: Bomb
attacks.desc: If the player is in close proximity to Jade, she'll drop a bomb at her feet.

attacks.name: Invisibility
attacks.desc: She'll occasionally go into stealth and change her positioning.

attacks.name: Deadeye
attacks.desc: She'll shout "One shot, one kill!" and shoot a tracking bullet.

attacks.name: Machine Gun
attacks.desc: At half health she'll shout "Dance for me!" and shoot 6 bullets in quick succession.

attacks.name: Chaos Barrage
attacks.desc: At half health she'll shout "You're done!" and throw 4 chaos bolts at the player.

attacks.name: Brutal and Incursion
attacks.desc: : She shoots more often, her regular shot can inflict stun and is often lead up with her Silence shot.

title: Jakira the Shadow Huntress
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Jakira the Shadow Huntress is a Level 75 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrols the roads of Southern Oakveil Woodlands
description: Jakira was not always a member of the Venom Blades. Like many, she first resisted their onslaught, standing against the great witch Megara and her raiders as they descended upon her homeland and consumed its forests. A master duelist, Jakira always believed in strength, and now she serves the strong with unflinching loyalty. Like many Venom Blades, she's mixed her skills with their corrupted magic, alchemy, and brutal techniques, always looking for new ways to prove herself and earn her place at her masters' side. Despite her stealthy nature, this cocky huntress always warns her prey just before she strikes.

title: Keely the Frost Archer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Keely the Frost Archer is a Level 20 V Blood Carrier.
location: Bandit Trapper Camp in Farbane Woods
description: A cold-hearted bandit lieutenant, she oversees the animal husbandry and leather tanning camp in Farbane. Once a member of the Dunley militia, she was removed from her position for her brutal battlefield decision-making. Aside from being a crack shot, her enchanted arrows rain down icy death.

attacks.name: Triple Shot
attacks.desc: She shoots 3 arrows at the same time in multiple directions and inflict .

attacks.name: Invisibility
attacks.desc: She turns invisible while running to reposition herself.

attacks.name: Arrow Barrage
attacks.desc: She shouts "Freeze!" and shoots 10 arrows upward that fall around her and inflict .

title: Kodia the Ferocious Bear
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Kodia the Ferocious Bear is a Level 35 V Blood Carrier.
description: This mother bear is said to be ancient. Rumor has it that she wears a scar from every Bandit King that has ever lived, a rite of passage for the position. Her life stands as testament to the fact that no bandit leader has ever done well enough to finish the job.

attacks.name: Smash
attacks.desc: Basic melee attack.

attacks.name: Crush
attacks.desc: It slams the ground, causing a large number of rocks to fall from the ceiling 4 times in a circle radiating out from them. These rocks cannot be blocked by counters.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.desc: It roars and glows red, automatically snaring the player and gaining increased attack speed for 3 attacks.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.desc: It crouches on its haunches before charging forward in a straight line.

title: Kriig the Undead General
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Kriig the Undead General is a Level 47 V Blood Carrier.
location: Haunted Iron Mine in Dunley Farmlands
description: A truly impressive strategic mind in life, Kriig saw an early end for his mistaken faith in his allies. Though he was sent to an unjust grave, he was like any great mastermind, and had contingencies in place for just such an occasion. A dark deal with an entity of undeath allowed him to rise again and take his revenge. Now he serves the Cult of the Damned with renewed purpose, fully immersing himself into their enigmatic cause.

attacks.name: Slash
attacks.desc: He sweeps his scythe in a wide arc forward, slashing a large area in front of him and on his sides.

attacks.name: Reaper Whirlwind
attacks.desc: His scythe glows green and he draws back his scythe horizontally behind him with both hands, before spinning in a circle while dashing forward. This attack snares the player if it hits them.

attacks.name: Chain Harpoons
attacks.desc: He draws back his left arm and throws 3 harpoons towards the player, which drag them back towards Kriig and briefly snare them if they hit.

attacks.name: Bone Circle
attacks.desc: Kriig raises his scythe in the air, and after a brief delay summons an unholy circle around him that deals damage in melee range.

attacks.name: Ward of the Damned
attacks.desc: He summons a shield similar to the player's Ward of the Damned, blocking any attacks that hit it and summoning skeletons that fight alongside Kriig.

title: Leandra the Shadow Priestess
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Leandra the Shadow Priestess is a Level 47 V Blood Carrier.
description: There are few creatures on the face of Vardoran as ancient as Leandra. Mysterious and surrounded with shadow magic and undeath, it is said that when Dracula fell, and the poisonous blood rains soaked Vardoran, she stood willingly in the deadly downpour. Some say she embraced the dark power of that corruption and made it her own. Today she serves as High Priestess of the Cult of the Damned.

attacks.name: Shadow Bolt
attacks.desc: She swings her left arm in a backhand motion, firing a single bolt of shadow at the player

attacks.name: Shadow Orbs
attacks.desc: She holds her left hand behind her as it glows purple, then fires three shadow orbs toward the player. The two orbs on the sides will arc in a semi-circle, and when all 3 orbs converge at the end of their arc they will detonate and deal damage in a large area around them.

attacks.name: Summon Shadow Soldier
attacks.desc: She raises her left hand in the air and summons a shadow soldier that dashes toward the player after a brief delay. The shadow will make a single melee attack and then disappear, but can also be destroyed earlier by taking any amount of damage.

attacks.name: Summon Shadow Army
attacks.desc: She levitates into the air and shouts "Do you hear them? They're coming!", and disappears as darkness obscures the edges of the player's vision. She then summons 4 shadow soldiers which will attack the player one after the other before disappearing. Leandra can use this ability multiple times per fight.

title: Lidia the Chaos Archer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Lidia the Chaos Archer is a Level 30 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrolling the roads of Farbane Woods
description: An adept but undisciplined archer, she lets her arrows fly and trusts that fate knows where to take them, and it works. Lidia is a force of chaos that cannot be contained, and the bandit king is happy to let her do as she likes as long as it benefits him.

attacks.name: Row Shots
attacks.desc: She shoots 3 arrows in a row that inflict .

attacks.name: Invisibility
attacks.desc: She goes turns invisible in order to run away and reposition.

attacks.name: Arrow Barrage
attacks.desc: She shouts "Think on your feet!" and shoot 4 arrows that leave an area of effect that inflicts .

title: Lord Styx the Night Champion
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Lord Styx the Night Champion is a Level 84 V Blood Carrier.
description: A legendary Vampire from the age of Dracula who was reawakened by the call of the Immortal King. Known for his ferocity on the battlefield against the forces of the church and rival Vampire alike, he has more than earned his place as the Night Champion of the Legion of Noctum. His presence over the operation at the heart of Dracula’s Demise must be of vital importance to Dracula’s plans.

attacks.name: Double Kill
attacks.desc: Styx does two fast slashes and a lunge.

attacks.name: Death Spin
attacks.desc: He spins in a circle firing red blades in a 360° angle dealing damage. His spin attack deals area damage (for the circle) while the blades deal single target damage.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.desc: At 80% health Styx unlocks a new ability. He teleports behind the player and dashes towards them.

attacks.name: Bat Swarm
attacks.desc: He summons three bat-energy balls. Two from the sides closing in on the player and one from the front (it can sometimes curve)

attacks.name: Gargoyles
attacks.desc: At 50% HP he jumps into the air and summons two gargoyles to aid him in the fight.

attacks.name: Ultimate Power
attacks.desc: Styx levitates into the air darkening the screen of the player and summons 10 of his bat swarm attacks.

attacks.name: Jump
attacks.desc: Styx can now jump into the air and inflict "Heart strike"

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.desc: He can now teleport behind the player.

title: Lucile the Venom Alchemist
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Lucile the Venom Alchemist is a Level 76 V Blood Carrier.
location: Venom Mixing Outpost in Oakveil Woodlands
description: An energetic, maniacal alchemist with a famously resilient constitution. Lucile obsesses over creating the perfect Venom Sap brew for any occasion. She credits her brilliance to her Queen, Megara, who she claims delivers her divine inspiration. That inspiration just so happens to strike when she forgets to switch out the filters in her protective face mask.

title: Mairwyn the Elementalist
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Mairwyn the Elementalist is a Level 70 V Blood Carrier.
description: A dangerous spell-caster in tune with the most ephemeral qualities of nature. Mairwyn speaks to the winds, which whisper for change, chaos, and destruction. However, she seems content to only massacre those who wander too close to her Grove.

attacks.name: Fire vortex
attacks.desc: Mairwyn conjures a fiery vortex, throwing out 4 fireballs at 90 degree angles to each other as she spins and moves around. The fireballs apply a burn debuff.

attacks.name: Sparkles
attacks.desc: Mairwyn puts an electric charge on the target, causing sparkles to spawn around them. They spawn in four directions around the taget, moving toward the target. The sparkles apply a stun.

attacks.name: Ice shard volly
attacks.desc: Mairwyn throws a volley of 3 ice shards, slowing on hit.

attacks.name: Large ice shard
attacks.desc: Mairwyn throws a large ice shard, stunning on hit.

attacks.name: Wind blast
attacks.desc: Mairwyn yells "Back to hell with you!" conjuring a large wind blast over a time. Enemies hit are sent flying outwards.

attacks.name: Mirror image
attacks.desc: Mairwyn turns invisible and teleports, creating a mirror image as she reappears. Both use the Shock blast ability at first, but Mairwyn herself switches to her normal abilities after a while.

attacks.name: Shock blast
attacks.desc: Mairwyn (or her mirror image) throws 3 lightning balls, stunning on hit.

attacks.name: Frost and fire
attacks.desc: Mairwyn freezes herself and summons a large fireball, the fireball rolls around, throwing small fireballs toward its target. the smaller fireballs can be intercepted by the frozen Mairwyn.

title: Maja the Dark Savant
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Maja the Dark Savant is a Level 47 V Blood Carrier.
location: The Forbidden Tower in Dunley Farmlands
description: A brilliant, obsessive scholar that resides in an ancient family library, discovering its long-lost secrets in pursuit of a goal intuitively passed through her family's bloodline. The culmination of generations of work is at her ink-stained fingertips... to open a way to the world of demons.

attacks.name: Paper Barrage
attacks.desc: She swings her book in front of her, firing 4 lines of pages at the player.

attacks.name: Ink Bolt
attacks.desc: She holds her left hand back then swings her wand and fires an ink projectile at the player. If it hits them, it summons an Ink Demon to aid Maja. This projectile pierces through enemies and can therefore summon multiple Ink Demons in a single cast if it hits multiple players or summons (e.g. the skeletons created by Unholy spells).

attacks.name: Ink Splatter
attacks.desc: She shouts "Flee interloper!" or "A taste of knowledge!", then creates a large ink area around her that explodes after a brief delay and summons an Ink Demon.

attacks.name: Summon Ink Demons
attacks.desc: She creates a small burst of ink dealing damage in an area around her, shouts "Rise Demons! Accept these vessels!" or "Witness my little devils!", then disappears while 3 ink projectiles begin springing up out of the ground. These projectiles create Ink Demons upon landing and will also snare the player if they hit them. Maja reappears in a random location once this attack ends.

attacks.name: Consume
attacks.desc: She shouts "A sacrifice is required!" or "Lend me your power!" before channeling to create a large book in front of her that shields an Ink Demon and begins to drag it towards her. If the Ink Demon is dragged all the way to the book, it slams shut around it, destroying the demon and healing Maja for a substantial amount of health. This ability can be canceled by killing the demon before it reaches the book.

attacks.name: Paper Cut
attacks.desc: She shouts "Death by a thousand paper cuts!" or "The exquisite suffering of a paper cut!" or "Here is some mandatory reading!" or "Do you also thirst for research?!", and summons 7 lines of pages that fire at the player, followed by 7 more from a different angle after a delay. These projectiles are spaced further apart than those created by her Paper Barrage ability and can be avoided by standing between them.

title: Matka the Curse Weaver
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Matka the Curse Weaver is a Level 76 V Blood Carrier.
description: Some say Matka is the oldest of the witches, but the truth is nobody knows how or when these timeless creatures were born. A force of nature and a mockery of humanity, she is utterly beyond reason.

attacks.name: Summon Mosquito
attacks.desc: Matka summons two mosquitoes (there isn't a limit to how many there it can be).

attacks.name: Swamp Bomb
attacks.desc: She summons three area of attack bombs that inflict fading snare.

attacks.name: Crawling Snake
attacks.desc: Matka summons a spell that crawls along the ground and summons a trio of explosions.

attacks.name: Pig Curse
attacks.desc: She'll say "veins of the world sing" and turn you into a pig for a few seconds and summon four of these snake spells.

attacks.name: Unstable Mosquito
attacks.desc: She will say "bones of the tree be mine" and summon five mosquitoes that will hunt you down and explode

title: Megara the Serpent Queen
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Megara the Serpent Queen is a Level 88 V Blood Carrier.
location: Venom Blades Bastion in Oakveil Woodlands
description: There was once a small village of warriors, a place of little significance. When the great witch Megara appeared the villagers reacted with suspicion, gathering their forces to stand against her. Megara gave them a display of power that inspired such terror it crushed all hope of resistance, driving them to their knees. "I am your Queen! The greatest half of you will become my first subjects, and will walk by my side. Come dusk, each of you that are holding the heart of one of your neighbors will earn your place." Those who obeyed became the first Venom Blades, worthy of receiving the secret of Venom Sap. This fuels their war effort, but more importantly, the great witch herself.

title: Meredith the Bright Archer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Meredith the Bright Archer is a Level 50 V Blood Carrier.
location: Haunted Iron Mine in Dunley Farmlands
description: Meredith is a true believer in the Church of Luminance. She believes her power is a gift from the Light to wield against dark forces, much as the original Paladins were given the Light to strike down Dracula and the Vampire legions. As brave as she is naive to the Church’s descent into avarice and gluttony, this holy archer is blinded by the light, focused only on her pursuit of justice at any cost.

attacks.name: Arrow Shot
attacks.desc: She fires a single arrow at the player.

attacks.name: Blessed Shot
attacks.desc: She shouts "Bless this shot!" then fires an an arrow in the direction the player is moving, predicting their path. This arrow deals heavy damage and incapacitates the player if it hits them.

attacks.name: Dash
attacks.desc: She occasionally dashes around the area up to 4 times, damaging targets she passes through.

attacks.name: Summon Militia Guard
attacks.desc: She shouts "For Luminance!", and summons 2 Militia Guards.

attacks.name: Arrow Barrage
attacks.desc: She shouts "Light, guide my arrows!", then shoots 10 arrows upward that will fall around her. This attack stuns the player if they get hit.

title: Morian the Stormwing Matriarch
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Morian the Stormwing Matriarch is a Level 70 V Blood Carrier.
description: The most dangerous of her kind, and fiercely protective of her tribe. It's said that the harpies are attracted to only the finest gemstones, and none has a sharper eye for quality than the matriarch herself. Wealthy folk are warned to keep their jewels out of sight if they dare travel outside the protection of Brighthaven.

title: Nibbles the Putrid Rat
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Nibbles the Putrid Rat is a Level 30 V Blood Carrier.
description: Farmers try to be diligent in keeping their pest problems under control, as legend says that any place too infested might find themselves visited by the Putrid Rat. No one is quite sure how it gets in, but they know it by the stench of rotting flesh and its carnivorous appetite.

attacks.name: Bite
attacks.desc: The standard melee attack.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.desc: Nibbles glows red, then melee attacks 6 times in a row.

attacks.name: Poison Explosion
attacks.desc: Nibbles shakes its coat and releases a green poison mist that explodes in an area around it after a delay.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.desc: Nibbles burrows into the ground, temporarily leaving the fight while summoning 3 Giant Rats. More rats will steadily join the fight until 9 have been summoned in total.

title: Nicholaus the Fallen
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Nicholaus the Fallen is a Level 35 V Blood Carrier.
description: A necromancer driven out of high society in Silverlight for his indulgence in the dark arts. Now he lives among the undead, using his unliving servants to fulfill his needs, as well as bring him back unwilling subjects for his experiments.

attacks.name: Green Bolt
attacks.desc: He fires a single skull ranged attack.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.desc: He raises up in the air, disappears, then creates an area of effect under the player. After a moment he reappears in the area, and inflicts Fear on the player if haven't left the area, forcing them to run away from him.

attacks.name: Skulls
attacks.desc: He says "Your bones will be mine!", then radiates 3 waves of skull projectiles in all directions around him. These projectiles wind back and forth while traveling through the air.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.desc: He says "Behold!", then summons 3 Armoured Skeletons and 1 Skeleton Crossbow (Armoured).

attacks.name: Summon Army
attacks.desc: He says "Let's test that meat suit of yours!", then summons a large group of 14 Skeletons.

title: Octavian the Militia Captain
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Octavian the Militia Captain is a Level 58 V Blood Carrier.
description: An old soldier and a veteran of many battles, Octavian is perhaps the most trusted man in all of Dunley. The militia serves him without question, and he in turn serves them to the best of his ability. Don't let his age fool you, he's got plenty of fight left in him.

attacks.name: Wide Swing
attacks.desc: He will swing his sword arching the front most of his sides and foreward, spawns a few projectiles

attacks.name: Greatsword Reverse
attacks.desc: He will swing his sword vertically which will shoot a projectile, if hit by the projectile will bring you right behind him and stun you.

attacks.name: Dash
attacks.desc: He will dash at you with his sword out.

attacks.name: Minion Summon
attacks.desc: He will yell "To me!" which will summon a Militia Longbow Enemies.

attacks.name: Enrage
attacks.desc: He will glow red and start dash striking you.

attacks.name: Hurricane Spin
attacks.desc: He will say "Here's an old trick" will start spinning around the arena, spawning projectiles as he spins.

attacks.name: Brutal and Incursion Rift
attacks.desc: : His Enrage is changed to a jump attack which he will do multiple jumps. He will also chain attack his Wide Swing and Greatsword Reverse.

title: Polora the Feywalker
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Polora the Feywalker is a Level 35 V Blood Carrier.
description: A powerful psychopomp that taps into mysterious spiritual sources. Polora is one of the only known mortal links to fairy kind and driven to the brink of sanity by her intimate connection to nature. Her dream-like home is alive with unique, enchanted plant life.

attacks.name: Spirit Wave
attacks.desc: Polora does a stationary channel, lifting her left arm up, before releasing 3 spread out spirit projectiles that move in a wave-like pattern.

attacks.name: Spirit Wolf
attacks.desc: Polora does a short channel in front of her before launching a spirit wolf in a straight line. The wolf deals damage/heals depending on target hit. After a short delay, the wolf will bounce to a new target, up to 5 times, for a total of 6 hits. It can bounce back to Polora.

attacks.name: Fear
attacks.desc: If the player is in close proximity to Polora, she'll shout "Begone!"and start a second long channel. When it ends she will Fear all targets in a small radius around her, forcing them to run away from her.

attacks.name: Invisibility
attacks.desc: If the player is in close proximity to Polora, she will turn invisible for a few seconds, and gain increased movement speed. If afflicted by , her movement can be tracked.

attacks.name: Summon Minion
attacks.desc: After losing 25% of her health, Polora will periodically shout "Spirits, hear me!" and summon a Pixie. They fire ranged wave-like spirit attacks, but their aiming turn rate is slower. If killed, Polora may resummon a new one.

title: Quincey the Bandit King
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Quincey the Bandit King is a Level 37 V Blood Carrier.
description: The 'King' of the bandits, once heralded as a hero of the common people in Dunley. His lack of proper reverence for the Church of Luminance saw him driven into Farbane, where his prowess in battle earned the respect of the banditry and, eventually, a place as their champion and king. He may have been a good man, once.

attacks.name: Double Swipe
attacks.desc: His basic melee attack consists of 2 swipes with his mace.

attacks.name: Shock Wave
attacks.desc: After a brief charge, he'll do a knockback melee attack that inflicts a minor debuff. He'll then create 4 waving shockwave lines that explode after a couple seconds that also inflict the lesser . Stacks with regular .

attacks.name: Mace Throw
attacks.desc: He throws his weapon, tracking player movement and snaring them if it hits.

attacks.name: Chaos Barrier
attacks.desc: He shouts "Show me what you've got!" and creates a reflective shield that inflicts if hit. The shield does not deflect AoE attacks such as Bone Explosion or the crossbow's Rain of Bolts.

attacks.name: Summon Minion
attacks.desc: He shouts "Rise to the challenge!" and spawns a Trapper.

attacks.name: Merciless Charge
attacks.desc: His shield will shine for a second before he does a charge attack that does heavy damage and stuns.

attacks.name: Triple Charge
attacks.desc: At half health he shouts "A rousing battle!" and does 3 charges in a row. He'll be briefly stunned afterwards.

title: Raziel the Shepherd
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Raziel the Shepherd is a Level 57 V Blood Carrier.
description: The head and heart of the Dunley Monastery and a true believer in the Light, Raziel is known for his persuasive sermons and harsh, fire-and-brimstone rhetoric. It is believed that his holy power is granted by his incredible righteousness, largely because he keeps saying so.

title: Rufus the Foreman
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Rufus the Foreman is a Level 20 V Blood Carrier.
location: Bandit Logging Camp in Farbane Woods
description: A lieutenant of the bandit forces charged with looking over the logging camp. Just because he's an expert woodworker doesn't mean he doesn't know his way around a crossbow, though. He didn't rise up in the bandit ranks for nothing.

attacks.name: Crossbow Bolt
attacks.desc: Rufus' standard attack. He fires a crossbow bolt with a red glow in a straight line.

attacks.name: Throw Net
attacks.desc: Much like the Trapper ability, Rufus swings a net around before throwing it into the AoE indicator. Any player still in that zone when he throws the net will be pinned in place for several seconds.

attacks.name: Dodge Roll
attacks.desc: If the player draws too close to him he can dodge-roll away.

attacks.name: Summon Minions
attacks.desc: Rufus calls for some minions, a Thug and a Poacher, to join the fight.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.desc: Rufus will shield himself and any of his nearby allies, similar to the Blood Rage ability.

attacks.name: Rapid Crossbow
attacks.desc: Once Rufus gets to about half health he says "I'm gonna call you target practice!" and fires 8 crossbow bolts in rapid succession. After that the weapon will clinck, indicating to the player that the attack is over.

title: Simon Belmont the Vampire Hunter
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Simon Belmont the Vampire Hunter is a Level 80+ V Blood Carrier. Simon Belmont is a uniquely level scaling V Blood Carrier, who starts at level 80, but will always match his opponent's gear level.
location: Patrols all the roads of Vardoran, ending in the Colosseum.
description: This mysterious Vampire hunter has arrived from lands unknown on a fervent mission to cut down anything they might deem a threat to mankind. Monster and Vampire alike will find themselves the target of this strangers ire, and even worse, on the wrong end of the exotic stranger's unique battle whip... an intriguing new tool of war.

title: Sir Erwin the Gallant Cavalier
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Sir Erwin the Gallant Cavalier is a Level 46 V Blood Carrier.
location: Horse Racing Track in Dunley Farmlands
description: Sir Erwin is an expert horseman, known both for his skill on horseback and unbearable company at formal events. Being generally disliked by his superiors but too skilled and devoted to the Light to exile to Farbane, he was instead sent to prepare for a grand offensive against the Cult of the Damned. Atop his fearless steed, Charger, he trains at the Dunley Horse Track, waiting for his promised troops. Surely, they'll arrive any day now.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.desc: His basic melee attack consisting of a delayed horizontal swing with his sword. This attack has low range but swings in a wide arc.

attacks.name: Twin Lightning
attacks.desc: He shouts "Twin Lightning!" or "Spears of Glory!" and fires 2 Ball Lightning projectiles. These projectiles track where the player is moving and launch in that direction rather than directly at the player. He will sometimes cancel this ability early to use another one, resulting in only 1 or even 0 projectiles.

attacks.name: Holy Artillery
attacks.desc: He shouts "Holy Artillery!" or "From the Heavens!" and 2 area of effect lightning blasts strike from the sky after a brief delay.

attacks.name: Stunning Leap
attacks.desc: His horse leaps high into the air, then crashes down dealing lightning damage in a large area. Erwin is briefly stunned after landing.

attacks.name: Lightning Charge
attacks.desc: He shouts "Bravely forward, Charger!", "Sally forth!", or "Charge!!!" and charges at the player, stunning them if he hits.

attacks.name: Hyper Charge
attacks.desc: His horse rears up on its hind legs, he raises his sword in the air, shouts "Charger, I think I've got it!", "Charge like thunder!", or "The Heavens are on my side!" and charges toward the player while small lightning bolts strike in a wave that follows his charge.

title: Sir Magnus the Overseer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Sir Magnus the Overseer is a Level 66 V Blood Carrier.
location: Sacred Silver Mine in Silverlight Hills
description: A fanatical servant of the Church of Luminance, his blind faith in the Light makes him the perfect candidate for Overseer of the Silver Mines. He is willing to look past the vile actions of the church, and even enforce them if it's in the interest of what he believes is the greater good. Even if it means doing something he might never condone, such as forced labor, or exiling his beloved daughter.

title: Solarus the Immaculate
intro: Solarus the Immaculate is a Level 86 V Blood Carrier.
description: A legendary paladin of the Light and the oldest living member of the Church of Luminance. He has watched firsthand the descent of mankind with disinterest. A pioneer from the age of heroes, he remembers the struggle of facing down Dracula’s armies until all hope was lost. He remembers finding the light... He remembers the satisfaction of lifting his holy blade to the Immortal King, and striking down the greatest evil the world has ever seen. He yearns to return to the days where he knew glory.

title: Stavros the Carver
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Stavros the Carver is a Level 75 V Blood Carrier.
location: Carvers Logging Outpost in Oakveil Woodlands
description: One will not expect a simple craftsman to be so vicious in battle, but none represent the Venom Blades' endless thirst for havoc and consumption better that Stavros. From carving the trees with runes of corruption to harvesting the Venom Sap those trees produce, he works with a cold glee. Whether it be bark or flesh, every cut of his knife is a show of his devotion to the great witch Megara. Like any Venom Blade, he loves and fears his queen in equal measure, revering her as a goddess and looking to her for higher purpose.

title: Talzur the Winged Horror
intro: Talzur the Winged Horror is a Level 86 V Blood Carrier.
description: A creature that was once one of Dracula’s favorite pets. The monster mourned the death of its master in a blood-soaked vigil, enduring the toxic, bloody rains that followed Dracula’s death for seven days and seven nights. Unlike the many creatures that suffered under the rains, this one embraced the agony. Through its love and devotion for the tyrant king, it was able to embrace all of the hatred passed down through the downpour’s curse and become The Winged Horror.

attacks.name: Retreat
attacks.desc: During the fight, The Winged Horror will retreat directly away from the player whenever they get close. This weirdly happens even if The Winged Horror itself gets close to the player instead of the other way around.

attacks.name: Debuffs
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror fight features two unique debuffs. The first is a damage over time, applied by it's Chaos attacks and the second one slowing down the player, applied by it's Frost attacks. If the player is burning and gets hit with a frost attack the burning will be cleansed and the slowing effect will take effect, and vice versa. This makes it so the player can never be affected by both debuffs at the same time. The debuffs last for about 10 seconds each.

attacks.name: Projectiles
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror's projectiles are either Chaos Volley style fireballs or Crystal Lance icicles, applying the burning and slowing debuffs respectively. The icicles in particular always split into two additional icicles, forming a Y pattern. These secondary icicles do not split further.

attacks.name: Fire Breath
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror flies up and spews fire down to the ground in one spot for a few seconds. Fireballs will shoot out from the location of the stream. When the fireballs land they deal damage and scorch the ground. The player will take damage and be inflicted with the burning debuff if they step on the scorched ground.

attacks.name: Flare Charge
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror will unfurl it's wings one at a time while also summoning a fireball on either side of it's body. Afterwards, it and the fireballs quickly charge towards the location it was facing, dealing damage to the player. If the player is hit by The Winged Horror instead of the fireballs, they will be pushed back and will very likely be attacked by a swipe. If the player is behind The Winged Horror, it is likely The Horror will attempt a Tail Whip instead. Later in the fight, the charge will spread scorched ground if it comes into contact with any.

attacks.name: Swipe and Tail whip
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror swipes forwards with it claws or whips with it's tail. Both attacks deal damage in an arc while shooting a volley of icicles. The tail whip is used only when the player is behind The Winged Horror.

attacks.name: Spin
attacks.desc: The Winged Horror curls up before spinning in place, dealing damage around itself and knocking back players while firing icicles all around itself.

attacks.name: Fireball Drop
attacks.desc: Starting at around 70% health, The Winged Horrror will fly up and across the battlefield while dropping fireballs that scorch the earth. Once it's done dropping fireballs, The Horror will violently crash back down to the arena. As the fight progresses, The Horror will do multiple flights over the battlefield, each with it's own set of fireballs.

attacks.name: Frost Vortex
attacks.desc: Starting at around 70% health, The Winged Horror will roar, causing snow to build up in an area. Shortly afterwards, a blizzard will appear in the area, dealing damage to players inside.

attacks.name: Fireball Volley 1
attacks.desc: Starting at around 50% health, The Winged Horror will breathe 4 sets of fireballs in a semi-circle in front of itself. The first and third set of fireballs are lighter in color and have consistent speed while the second and fourth set have darker and move at different speeds, causing them to cover the space between the first and third set's space in between the fireballs. The fireballs leave behind scorched earth when they disappear.

attacks.name: Fireball Volley 2
attacks.desc: Starting at around 30% health, The Winged Horror will spawn 2 Chaos vortexes on either side of itself and begin violently batting it's wings, causing a strong gust of wind. The player is pushed back constantly by the wind while the vortexes shoot fireballs towards the player. The batting of it's wings will also spread scorched earth if any is caught in the area.

title: Terah the Geomancer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Terah the Geomancer is a Level 53 V Blood Carrier.
description: The result of a long line of earth speakers, Terah resides up in the solitude of the mountains among sparkling gem veins and rugged boulders. Despite her stoic appearance and demeanour, communing with the spirits of nature has driven her quite insane.

title: Terrorclaw the Ogre
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Terrorclaw the Ogre is a Level 76 V Blood Carrier.
description: A creature whose story has long since been lost to the ages, thought not without resemblance to some few legendary creatures that were once men. One cannot help but wonder what strange corruption has taken root in Vardoran.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw swipes in front of him, then slams forward, freezing.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw roars, then leaps forward and bites.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw slams the ground, creating three lines of ice. After a delay, icicles appear on the lines, freezing. Ice Block/Phantom Aegis can be used to MITIGATE the damage received if a dodge/side step is not an option for you or a teammate.

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw roars, incapacitating nearby enemies.

attacks.name: Icicles
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw slams the ground multiple times, causing icicles to be dropped on the ground. These block most of his abilites.

attacks.name: Throw ice
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw picks up a icicle, then throws to the player stunning on hit. This projectile pierces icicles on the ground. Looks to be intercepting (aimed toward a location which would hit if the target kept moving in the same direction). This attack can be fully parried with abilities such as Blood Rite, abilities such as Ward Of The Damned will NOT work(Ward of the Damned appears to work as of the Gloomrot update).

attacks.name: Freezing breath
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw glows blue-white, then releases two waves in a large cone, freezing. The damage scales with proximity. This attack is blocked by icicles.

attacks.name: Arctic leap
attacks.desc: Terrorclaw leaps in the air, slamming down in a large area dealing AoE damage. Upon landing, 4 novas of frost radiate out from the center, freezing.

title: Tristan the Vampire Hunter
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Tristan the Vampire Hunter is a Level 44 V Blood Carrier.
location: Roaming the roads of Farbane Woods & Dunley Farmlands
description: A cold-blooded killer, and the scion of a long line of vampire hunters. Few are as prepared to face the rising tide of vampire threat as Tristan, and his drive to exterminate the last of the unholy threat is second to none.

attacks.name: Flaming strike
attacks.desc: He coats his sword with fire and then swipes forward in an overhead swing after a short delay. This attack lights the player on fire if it hits them.

attacks.name: Icy swing
attacks.desc: He coats his sword with ice and then immediately sweeps it in a wide arc in front of him that inflicts . He often uses this as a follow-up attack after Flaming strike.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.desc: He leaps forward while thrusting his sword. This attack briefly snares the player if it hits them, but can be blocked by counter or shield abilities.

attacks.name: Flaming Crossbow
attacks.desc: He draws his crossbow and fires a flaming bolt at the player. If the bolt hits the player, a minion, or the environment it will detonate and light a large area of the ground on fire. If blocked by a shield spell or countered, the bolt will disappear without leaving a flame patch.

attacks.name: Fire Bombs
attacks.desc: He throws a fire bomb in the air which explodes into 5 separate bombs, lighting the ground on fire for several seconds when they land. He will often follow up this attack by firing his crossbow immediately afterwards.

title: Ungora the Spider Queen
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Ungora the Spider Queen is a Level 63 V Blood Carrier.
description: A massive spider of legendary age and progeny. The Spider Queen resides in the twisted, web-woven depths of Cursed Forest's winding caverns. No living creature save for her children has ever entered and lived to tell the tale.

title: Vincent the Frostbringer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Vincent the Frostbringer is a Level 44 V Blood Carrier.
location: Patrols the roads of Dunley Farmlands
description: A stalwart champion of law and order in Dunley, it's his mission to protect the common people with his chilling gifts. Some say his methods have been getting more harsh and violent ever since his sister was banished.

attacks.name: Double Swipe
attacks.desc: His basic melee attack consists of 2 swipes with his mace that inflict .

attacks.name: Frost Barrier
attacks.desc: He creates a reflective shield that radiates a cone of frost damage which inflicts if hit. The shield does not deflect AoE attacks such as Bone Explosion or the crossbow's Rain of Bolts.

attacks.name: Crystal Lance
attacks.desc: He holds his shield in the air, then swipes it in front of him, firing 5 ice projectiles in a cone that inflict . This ability is signaled by a distinct shrill sound effect.

attacks.name: Chill Charge
attacks.desc: He shouts "I feel a chill coming on!" and gains increased movement speed as well as ice particles around his feet. After running back and forth for a moment he will charge toward the player and inflict if he hits them, then repeat this process 2 more times.

attacks.name: Ice Vortex
attacks.desc: He holds his shield in the air and conjures a large vortex of ice around him that inflicts . After a brief delay the vortex detonates, dealing massive damage to players inside it. The explosion deals damage a little further than the area indicates and the damage cannot be blocked by counter or barrier spells but can be dodged with a Veil dash.

title: Voltatia the Power Master
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Voltatia the Power Master is a Level 79 V Blood Carrier.
location: Trancendum Power Plant in Gloomrot North
description: The trusted Right Hand of Doctor Henry Blackbrew, Voltatia is responsible for the maintenance and protection of the entire electric pipeline of Gloomrot, providing the region with their much needed energy supply. A stern professional and born leader, Voltatia operates with psychotic efficiency, and has little emotional desire beyond keeping The Doctor's operation running smoothly.

title: Willfred the Village Elder
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Willfred the Village Elder is a Level 64 V Blood Carrier.
description: An honored and deeply respected chief of a small, reclusive village of outcasts. Despite the imminent threat of the Cult of the Damned, dangerous wildlife, and even the rumor of Werewolves stalking northern Dunley, he manages to keep his people fed and happy.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.desc: Willfred will swipe at you up to 2 times. This is extended if he hits both swipes, or cut short if you leave his range.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.desc: Willfred glows red, walks towards you quickly, and bites at you 3 times in quick succession.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.desc: Willfred gets on all fours and prepares to lunge at you. This will inflict a 3 second stun and deal heavy damage as he shouts "Hold still".

attacks.name: Heart Strike
attacks.desc: Willfred will turn invisible and encircle his prey. On Brutal Difficulty, Willfred will also summon a Frost Wolf for every player in combat. When he reveals himself again, Willfred will lunge at you with an attack that inflicts the Heart Strike debuff, This explodes and deals damage after 3 seconds. This attack's application and explosion cannot be countered, only evaded If an invulnerability effect is active when the effect expires, such as that from a successful counter or a dash, no damage will be taken . Occasionally Willfred will summon a copy of himself, which also performs Heart Strike once in close proximity. This appears to trigger randomly. Citation needed

title: Ziva the Engineer
intro: __TOC__ __NOTOC__ Ziva the Engineer is a Level 60 V Blood Carrier.
location: Trancendum Machine Factory in Gloomrot South
description: The beloved head engineer of weapons at the Machine Factory, Ziva is the embodiment of perfectly delightful destruction. Truly in love with her deadly experiments, she is always at the forefront at pushing for greater means of bringing a suitably painful and spectacular death to whoever ends up on the wrong end of her unstable technology. Which end often changes from trigger pull to trigger pull.
